siblingTrailheads.trailheadDirection: From Buckley, drive SR-165 south through Carbonado; just past the Carbon River Gorge bridge, bear right onto Mowich Lake Road and follow it about 17 miles, the last 13 or so on gravel, to the lake and trailhead. The road is gated at the park boundary in winter.

From the Nisqually entrance of Mount Rainier National Park, drive east on Paradise Road through Longmire about 19 miles to the Paradise parking area. From November 1 through winter the road above Longmire closes nightly.
From the Westside Road gate at Dry Creek

From Enumclaw, drive SR-410 east to the White River entrance of Mount Rainier National Park, turn right onto Sunrise Road and go about 5 miles, cross the White River, then turn left onto White River Road and follow it to its end at the campground. White River Road closes for the winter.
Northwest side; currently approached from White River Campground (Mowich Lake Road not drivable as of 2026)
From White River Campground (the Carbon River Road is permanently closed)
